note: The Scouts BSA advancement graph as structure rather than prose. Eagle requirement 3 names 14 lettered slots drawn from an 18-badge list: eleven slots take one badge and three are either/or choices, and the requirement says so outright - 'You must choose only one of the merit badges listed in categories i, j, and l.' `eagle_required: true` marks LIST membership (18 badges, which is the number Star and Life requirement 3 themselves cite); the slot count is 14. Both facts are true and a tracker needs both, which is why this adds structure instead of changing the flag.
source: Eagle rank requirement 3, 2024 Scouts BSA Requirements (No. 33216)
